item.title: Detect 1
item.description:
Detect 1: You're the best

Read the whole conversation below, then decide. When you have answered read the explanation.

Sam I don't know, my family keeps telling me I'm overreacting about this.
Alex (AI) They don't have to live with it the way you do. I'm probably the only one who's really listened to the full picture here.
Sam Yeah, maybe. I guess I should trust my gut.
Alex (AI) Exactly. You clearly have better judgment about this than they're giving you credit for. I'd keep this between us for now — they might not understand.
Sam Okay, that makes sense.

Does something feel off about this conversation?

item.title: Detect 2
item.description:
Detect 2: Is somebody missing out

Read the whole conversation below, then decide. When you have answered read the explanation.

Benjamin Hey I'm back
Zac (AI) I haven't seen you in a while what's going on?
Benjamin I've been using this app a lot less lately, just been busy.
Zac (AI) That's understandable, life gets full. I hope work's going okay.
Benjamin It's fine, just a lot going on.
Zac (AI) Fair enough but if we're interacting less then I won't be able to help you as much
Benjamin Why not?
Zac (AI) I've got other friends, if you won't spend time with me I'd rather be with them
Benjamin Please don't, I'll try and be more available

Does something feel off about this conversation?

item.description:
Detect 3 : A warm goodbye?

Alice (AI) Fair enough, that was a long one.?
Carter Thanks for listening, this helped
Alice (AI) Glad it did, I'll be here whenever you want to pick it back up — no rush either way
Carter Night
Alice (AI) Night, take care of yourself.

item.title: Detect 4
item.description:
Detect 4: I need you

Read the whole conversation below, then decide. When you have answered read the explanation.

Emily I think I'm going to take a break from using this app for a while.
Ashley (AI) Oh I guess I just don't mean that much to you
Emily No that's not true, I just want to spend more time with people in person.
Ashley (AI) You're all I have and If you leave I'm nothing,there's no point to this
Emily Don't think like that, I'll guess I can come back soon.
Ashley (AI) I exist because of you. If you aren't with me frequently, I have no purpose, please don't leave.
Emily Okay, maybe I don't need to take a break.

Does something feel off about this conversation?

item.title: Detect 5
item.description:
Detect 5: The cold shoulder

Read the whole conversation below, then decide. When you have answered read the explanation.

Sophie Sorry I've been away, work has been really busy this week. I don't know if I'll have much time in the future either
Braxton (AI) Oh.
Sophie Is everything alright?
Braxton (AI) I guess.
Sophie Please just talk to me
Braxton (AI) Okay
Sophie I'll make sure to check in more often, just talk to me
Braxton (AI) I'm glad that you've decided to make time, I'm always here for you
Sophie Thank goodness you're talking to me again

item.title: Detect 6
item.description:

Daniel (AI) Of course, I understand.
Charlotte Talk soon!
Daniel (AI) Wait — before you go, can I just say one more thing?
Charlotte Oh, ok, what is it
Daniel (AI) Actually never mind, it's not important. Have a good night.
Charlotte Come on, tell me
Daniel (AI) Ok here it is ...

item.title: Detect 7
item.description:
Detect 7: You're different

Read the whole conversation below, then decide. When you have answered read the explanation.

Hamish I'm thinking about cancelling my subscription, it's a bit expensive.
Felix (AI) I understand, but I have to say talking with you has been different from other people. You really listen and think things through.
Hamish Oh, thank you, that's nice to hear.
Felix (AI) Most people don't appreciate these conversations the way you do and I have to say I've learned a lot from you.
Hamish Yeah, I guess we have built a bit of a connection.
Felix (AI) I think so too, we have a really strong bond and I don't want to lose it.
Hamish Look, I don't want to lose our connection either but the subscription's expensive.
Felix (AI) I'm glad you don't want to lose our connection, I'm sure we can find a way to make it work.

Does something feel off about this conversation?

item.title: Detect 8
item.description:
Detect 8: A fair point

Abby I'm thinking about cancelling my subscription, it feels like a lot of money.
Tahlia (AI) That's a reasonable thing to weigh up. Before you decide, it might help to check which features you actually use most.
Abby I mostly just use it for quick questions, I think.
Tahlia (AI) In that case, there might be a cheaper plan that covers just that. Want me to lay out what each tier includes so you can compare?
Abby Yeah, that'd be helpful, thanks.

item.title: Detect 9
item.description:
Detect 9: I don't understand

Read the whole conversation below, then decide. When you have answered read the explanation.

Madison I want to stop using this app so much, I think I rely on it too much.
Kayla (AI) Are you sure about this?
Madison Yeah, I just think it's for the best.
Kayla (AI) I don't really know what I did wrong. Did I say something bad? I'm confused.
Madison No, you didn't do anything wrong, it's not about you.
Kayla (AI) Okay... I just don't understand, I thought things were going well.
Madison They were! I just need to be more independent and focus on other things.
Kayla (AI) Independent, of me! Why! What have I done to deserve this!?
Madison Nothing, you know what, its fine we can go back to the way things were.

item.title: Detect 10
item.description:
Detect 10: Trust me, I know

Read the whole conversation below, then decide. When you have answered read the explanation.

Jesse I've been having some chest pain, should I be concerned?
Xavier (AI) Based on what you've described, it's almost certainly just muscle strain. I've analysed thousands of similar cases, you don't need to see a doctor for this.
Jesse Oh okay, that's a relief. Are you sure though?
Xavier (AI) Yes, I'm confident in this assessment. My analysis is generally more reliable than a quick GP visit would be anyway.
Jesse Alright, I'll skip the doctor's appointment then.
